# Pipper Code

> Pipper is a free desktop app for running, directing, and improving multiple AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot, Grok — from a single interface instead of a wall of terminals. It is an AI agent interface and harness built on the Agent Client Protocol (ACP).

Pipper Code is an Electron desktop application for macOS and Windows. It sits between you and the agents you already use, giving them a shared workspace, parallel runs, and a single review surface. Your prompts, code, and agent activity stay local to your machine.
